title: Optimization of bacterial biorefineries for sustainable biodiesel production and flue gas reduction: a holistic approach to climate change mitigation and circular economy
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,1683-1708
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01516A, Communication
Rachael Jovita Barla, Suresh Gupta, Smita Raghuvanshi
The overview of climate change, the integrated bioreactor system, together with a life cycle assessment, a techno-economic analysis, and the implications for promoting a circular economy is discussed.
